876-5168-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Bloom Tender.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Bloom Tender.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Bloom Tender.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Bloom Tender.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Bloom Tender.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Bloom Tender from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-5319-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
3967-5319-6972.notes: If Geralf's Messenger starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

6266-7500.easyPrerequisites: Redshift, Rocketeer Chief does not have summoning sickness.
6266-7500.notablePrerequisites: Redshift, Rocketeer Chief has power 6 or greater.
6266-7500.description:
Activate Redshift by tapping it, adding at least {6} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Ringing Strike Mastery by paying {5}, untapping Redshift.
Repeat.

792-5686-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
792-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Totentanz and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

546-4499-4613-7234.easyPrerequisites: There are a total of at least five cards in all hands.
546-4499-4613-7234.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Realm Seekers. Realm Seekers enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Realm Seekers using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

489-2661-3692.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Aethersnipe for its evoke cost by paying {U}{U}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Aethersnipe enters the battlefield, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Resolve the first Aethersnipe trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Aethersnipe trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

147-6798-7281.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-6798-7281.description:
Cast Leonardo's Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Leonardo's Technique.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Leonardo's Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Leonardo's Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-6798-7281.notes: If desired, you can cast Leonardo's Technique for its sneak cost instead, reducing the mana cost by {2}.

1409-2307-6441.description:
Activate Corsair Captain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Corsair Captain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Corsair Captain.
Resolve the Corsair Captain trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is modified

4038-5845-5963.notes: If Marvin isn't modified, you can use Orochi Merge-Keeper's first ability instead the first iteration, adding {1} to the starting cost.

2034-2781-4681.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-6006-7060-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6006-7060-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2034-3490-4017-5870.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-4017-5870.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

3967-5220-6539-6900.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

1495-4029-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Triskelion triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Benevolent Hydra.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
1495-4029-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

144-5434-6797.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 greater than the largest life total among your opponents.
144-5434-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, its first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, and then turning it face up.
Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

1323-4188-4687.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
1323-4188-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Accomplished Alchemist's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

225-5720-5721-6620.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
225-5720-5721-6620.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 5 for each remaining trigger.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Resolve all Sylvan Safekeeper abilities.

5147-5972-6054.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
5147-5972-6054.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

643-1429-2034-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
643-1429-2034-5402.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {C}{C}.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

955-1069-3552-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
955-1069-3552-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

2102-3814-4452.notablePrerequisites:
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional land.
2102-3814-4452.description:
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Griffin Canyon and another land.
Activate Griffin Canyon's second ability by tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder and giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2438-3327-4549.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game
2438-3327-4549.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Dargo, adding {R}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

224-3703-5627.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-3703-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sporemound and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

914-3045-4013.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3045-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}{R} that can only be spent as though it were colorless mana due to Celestial Dawn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may tap and sacrifice them to get infinite {W} that can be spent as any color, or infinite mana of any other color that can only be spent as though it were colorless mana.

2713-4385-5231.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Sliver token, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1908-4364.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1908-4364.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Aurelia.
Put all but one Aurelia into your graveyard due to the legend rule, ensuring the remaining Aurelia has not attacked this turn.
Declare the remaining Aurelia as an attacker.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3094-4659-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, targeting any artifact.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Mishra's ability, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Mishra's ability, creating a token copy of Lithoform Engine that is a 4/4 creature with haste named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
Activate Mishra's Warform's first ability by paying {2}, and tapping it, copying Mishra's ability, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mishra's Warform, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

967-2034-3114-3705-3809.description:
Cast Yawgmoth's Will by paying {2}{B}, causing all cards put into your graveyard this turn to be exiled.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {C}{C}.
Squee is put into exile instead of your graveyard due to Yawgmoth's Will.
Cast Squee from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

281-1462-3149.description: At the begining of your upkeep, destroy all permanents your opponent control.

776-1329-4534-5281.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Barrage Ogre do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-4534-5281.description:
Tap Barrage Ogre, sacrificing Herbal Poultice to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Herbal Poultice.
Cast Herbal Poultice.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

157-168-207-539.description:
Cast Ashaya.
Admonition Angels landfall ability triggers, exiling Detention Sphere.
Detention Sphere's LTB triggers, returning Oblivion Ring to the battlefield.
Oblivion Ring's ETB triggers, exiling Admotion Angel.
Admonition Angel's LTB triggers, returning Detention Sphere to the battlefield.
Detention Sphere's ETB triggers, exiling Oblivion Ring.
Oblivion Ring's LTB triggers, returning Admonition Angel to the battlefield.
Admonition Angel's landfall ability triggers, exiling Detention Sphere.
Repeat.
